privacy.dateHandling: shifted by a per-packet number of days, intervals kept

overRedaction.definition: [name] tokens whose original text holds no word of the packet's fictional patient or provider name

extraction.offsetBasis: predictions reference redacted OCR, gold references original source. Dates are unshifted and date tokens restored before quotes are compared

verifier.challengeType: three deterministic unsupported mutations per packet, not semantic validation

coverage.definition: Pages, page counters, turns and low-confidence lines come from the OCR output alone and go into the pipeline. Unread source lines compare OCR with the source text, so they are an evaluation measure only and never reach the pipeline.

unreadSourceLines.definition: source lines with visible text, matched whole line to whole line with the OCR lines, of which fewer than a quarter of the characters come back from the matched OCR line unchanged and in order

reviewerOverrideRate.reason: No observed nurse study. Scripted UI actions are not workflow evidence.

hostedComparison.reason: Local only. No paid API or external document transfer.
